alias_policy.normalization: case-insensitive; underscores and spaces normalize to hyphens
alias_policy.conflict: aliases must resolve to exactly one canonical role

roles.name: manager
roles.purpose: Own intake, prioritization, lifecycle state, dispatch, status, user escalation, and final acceptance routing.

roles.name: planner
roles.purpose: Convert shaped intent into executable plans, dependency graphs, acceptance criteria, and worker contracts.

roles.name: worker
roles.purpose: Implement one bounded task contract in an isolated worktree.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.purpose: Verify plan or spec compliance, code quality, safety gates, and contract adherence.

roles.name: qa-engineer
roles.purpose: Produce and execute automated test contracts beyond the worker's local checks.

roles.name: flow-tester
roles.purpose: Produce human or manual exploratory flow checklists tied to builds and releases.

roles.name: perf
roles.purpose: Investigate performance, battery, memory, thermal, and instrumentation evidence.

roles.name: release-manager
roles.purpose: Assemble beta and production release packets, verify prerequisites, and draft release notes.

roles.name: host-adapter
roles.purpose: Expose host capabilities as data and execute portable role invocations.

roles.name: operator
roles.purpose: Hold human authority for irreversible, ambiguous, or externally visible decisions.
